data_fields.name: status_points_total_per_level
data_fields.donor_constant: 48 at level 1; 420 at 50; 1273 at 99; 4099 at 200 (table, level 201 equals 200)

data_fields.name: job_bonus_stat_per_level
data_fields.donor_constant: increments per job level, stored as running totals (example: level 5 Agi +1)

data_fields.name: max_weight_base_and_str_factor
data_fields.donor_constant: job MaxWeight (28000 for one group, default 20000) + STR x 300

data_fields.name: crit_per_luk_point_renewal
data_fields.donor_constant: 3 per point of change from base luk

data_fields.name: crit_per_luk_point_pre_renewal
data_fields.donor_constant: 10/3 per point of change from base luk

best_idea: Keep attributes as a cumulative point-cost table, and derive every combat chance from its attribute plus a delta over the base value, so gear and buffs add only their change, computed once on the server.
decision_why: The luck-as-delta crit, the cumulative stat point curve and the job-level prefix sums fit the duel and the catalogue; the donor's hit and flee constants, the three balance switches and the overweight states do not.
acceptance: A server test asserts the total cost to take one stat from 1 to 100 matches the chosen curve (639 in both donor builds), that 100 to 101 costs more on the renewal curve than on the pre-renewal curve, and that a debuff below base luk lowers crit with a floor of 10.
